title: Characteristic localization, sharp lifespan asymptotics and global dynamics for a one-dimensional derivative wave equation
summary: We study the Cauchy problem $$ v_{tt}-v_{xx}=\abs{v_t+v_x}^{m}\abs{v_t}^{n}, \qquad v(x,0)=η\varphi(x),\quad v_t(x,0)=ηψ(x), $$ on $\R$, with compactly supported profiles $\varphi\in C_0^2(\R)$, $ψ\in C_0^1(\R)$, exponents $m,n>1$, and amplitude $η>0$. We show that the sign of $P_0=ψ+\varphi'$ decides the behaviour of small solutions, whatever the sign of $ψ-\varphi'$. If $P_0$ is positive at some point, the lifespan $T(η)$ obeys explicit two-sided bounds of order $η^{-(m+n-1)}$ for every $η>0$, and $$ \lim_{η\to0^+}η^{m+n-1}T(η)=\frac{2^{n}}{(m+n-1)\,(\max_{\R}P_0)^{m+n-1}} . $$ If…
